rules.rule: Brand is NOT a taxonomy level
rules.detail: Brand is horizontal attribute. No Brand→Category→Product hierarchy.
Factory photos must not go into any industrial system.

rules.rule: Seal: asset_type=component, system_type may be null
rules.detail: Seals serve all systems. Do not force into one system.

rules.rule: Filter: must sub-type before system assignment
rules.detail: Filter alone cannot → Air Compressor. Determine air/oil/dust/hydraulic filter first.

rules.rule: Oil Separator → Air Compressor Systems → Compressor Components
rules.detail: In this dataset, oil separators are compressor-specific.

rules.rule: Dryer → Air Compressor Systems → Air Treatment

rules.detail: null/unknown/ambiguous are valid outputs. Never force classify.

rules.rule: AI must not override human-reviewed fields
rules.detail: If review.status=reviewed or locked_fields set, skip those fields.
